messages:
pagerbot: PAGER — spike: 5xxs on /v1/generate. error rate 18% over 5m, latency up in EU/APAC. sev: P2. Please acknowledge.

ashwin: ack. seeing a lot of TLS handshake failures from Cloudflare edge -> our api-gateway, plus 524s. logs: 
`tls: handshake failure` and `upstream timed out (110)` repeated.

incident-bot: Incident created: CF-edge & DNS disruption impacting API reachability. Runbook: cf-edge-dns-fallback. Channel: #incidents.

sre-rotation: i'm on call, taking lead. ashwin you triage CF edge logs + traceroute, lisa check auth failures (Okta token errors?) and maya verify evals/observability ingestion delays.

lisa: confirmed: spikes of HTTP 502/503 include auth token validation failures — Okta returns 500/504 intermittently for our introspect calls. looks correlated with CF POP list below.

maya: datadog/observability metrics are delayed ~2-3m, some traces missing. we might be blind on some failovers. opened ticket with datadog support (case #123456).

ashwin: quick diagnostics:
```
# from our edge logs
2026-05-12T14:02:12Z gateway[proxy]: tls: handshake failure from 141.101.64.0/18 (cloudflare)
2026-05-12T14:02:13Z gateway[upstream]: 524 upstream timeout to origin-a
```

ashwin: traceroute from affected CF IPs shows route via LHR/AMS POPs with high retransmits.

opsbot: applied temporary route override: `origin_bypass=true` for route /v1/generate for 10m while we assess. will roll back automatically.

oncall-a: good call. activating fallback to direct-origin for EU/UK/IE ip-cidr ranges. need approval for certificate handshake mode change (disable HTTP/2 to force TLS1.2 renegotiation) — risky but might reduce handshake failures.

security-bot: note: changing TLS/HTTP2 settings will change client-facing connection patterns. we should confirm no customer key/certificate constraints.

lisa: Okta status shows increased errors in EU region — shared status link: https://status.okta.com/incidents/abc123 (partial service degradation). this likely explains token validation 5xxs.

maya: datadog admitting ingestion delay: "we're experiencing a metrics ingestion spike in EU causing pipeline lag". that explains missing traces.

ashwin: coordinated plan: 1) keep origin_bypass for 15m; 2) route around LHR/AMS POPs via CF geo-steer if available; 3) fallback token validation: cache introspect results for 60s for critical endpoints to avoid cascade; 4) notify customers.

sre-rotation: executing steps 1+3 now. ashwin please run a smoke check after 60s.

ashwin: smoke after route-change: `curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate` -> 200 OK from us-east origin, latency dropped from 1200ms to 180ms for a test trace.

lisa: auth cache patch deployed (short TTL). token introspect errors reduced in our logs. still seeing occasional TLS handshake errors for some legacy clients.

maya: dashboards still partial, but synthetic checks show service recovered for most endpoints in EU. Datadog ingestion lag improving per support.

incident-bot: Update: incident severity set to P2 -> Customer-impacting partial outage. Recorded mitigations and timeline.

oncall-a: customer impact assessment: ~28% of production traffic saw errors in last 20m, primarily EU and APAC. No data exfiltration. Affected features: hosted API (generation) and some auth flows. Dedicated/reserved customers on private deployments not impacted.

ashwin: next actions: monitor 30m, coordinate with CF support for edge POP remediation, continue to cache introspect for 60s, and plan a controlled rollback of origin_bypass once CF reports stable.

lisa: notifying onboarding and support with template: "We're investigating elevated errors impacting API reachability in EU/APAC tied to third-party CDN and auth provider issues. Workaround in place. We're monitoring and will share updates."

opsbot: scheduled automated rollback of origin_bypass at +15m unless overridden.

sre-rotation: handoff note for next oncall: if errors reappear, escalate to CF L3 and Okta ops immediately; preserve logs and traces (dd links in incident doc).

maya: filing post-incident tickets: (1) add route-health autopromote for cross-pop failover, (2) longer auth-introspect caching for burst scenarios, (3) alerting: add synthetic check per CF POP for TLS handshake.

ashwin: closing on-call shift — continued monitoring. will update incident timeline in pagerduty and attach snippets. please react with :thumbsup: once you've seen the mitigation and no further action is required.

pagerbot: Incident acknowledged and being monitored.
